shared_ledgers.note: This order READ the shared cross-run ledgers and wrote neither. Writing them is a serialized-boundary action.

prior_position.note: Pittsburgh has never bought a places/identity lookup. Every dollar it has spent went on fetching pages.

this_order.authorization_basis: Firecrawl bills in PLAN CREDITS with no per-request USD. The credit position was read live before the run (515) and again after (513), so the figure is a measured delta and not an estimate. Two credits of 515 at $0 marginal is inside standing doctrine; no dollar authorization was required or assumed.

firecrawl_readiness.why: Every remaining unresolved row is either on a MEASURED capability wall (Marriott, Hilton), on a cost-excluded brand (Hyatt), blocked on a route rather than a fetch, or already answered. The ladder derived two candidates for this order and both were spent.

conditional_future_candidate.becomes_eligible_if: founder item PGH-R1-A3 binds this identity to a wyndhamhotels.com property route, which moves it from a bare independent onto the WYNDHAM family the route table names from a measured decision.

brightdata_readiness.why_paid_stays_closed: Every remaining unresolved row is blocked on a ROUTE or an IDENTITY, and buying a page supplies neither. Five of them point at property codes their own brand no longer publishes, so a paid fetch would buy a 404 or the wrong building. This reproduces the conclusion order 007 reached, now on stronger evidence: the brands' own sitemaps.

do_not_duplicate.note: Six rows that had already cost a paid attempt were closed in this order at $0 through the free attended lane. Re-sending any of the 17 without a material change in premises would be a duplicate attempt.

places_readiness.pricing_state: Pittsburgh has never made a discovery lookup, so this market has no measured rate.
places_readiness.why: The identity questions this order opened are answered by founder rulings and by brand sitemaps already read for free, not by buying a third-party record of where a hotel is.

recommendation: Pittsburgh needs no provider spend to reach its next promotion. The remaining work is founder rulings plus free reads.
